origin: variant of corpus/thaw-after-isolation-exec.json with the SIGSTOP 11 s into the isolation instead of 6 s, so the daemon more often writes to its signaling socket while isolated and that write is still unacked when it stops; on 9a0e4b22a exec bravo->alpha then timed out twice after heal (2/18): the socket's retransmit timer had backed off to 52 s and every new write queued behind it
